messages:
maya.parker: evening pulse — pushing train v1.12 now. cherry-pick #432 (fix/cache-bust) -> canary. blocked: flaky e2e failing in inference_tests::sequence on tf-serving image. @oliver can you take a look? ETA?

oliver.kim: on it. grabbing logs now. @derek can you hold merges to stable for ~30m?

derek.jones: added hold tag to stable queue, will pause merges. ping me when rollback needed.

ci-bot: [ci] canary build: integration-tests/sequence failing (1/5). Auto-retry queued.

oliver.kim: quick skim of failing trace shows kv-cache eviction NPE at step 174. suspect recent cache-bust change. Suggest revert cherry-pick for canary with:
```
git checkout train-branch
git revert --no-commit <commit-sha-432>
git commit -m "revert: cherry-pick #432 (temp rollback for e2e stability)"
git push origin train-branch
```
Maya ok to apply rollback?

maya.parker: yes please revert, and add a note on the release board. I'll open a follow-up ticket for tuning eviction thresholds. :+1:

oliver.kim: reverted the commit and pushed. second canary run started — looks green so far :white_check_mark:. opening PR to adjust eviction policy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/867

derek.jones: great — lifting hold in 10. good job team, keep me posted if flake resurfaces.
